🎬 Wonder (2017)

Wonder follows August “Auggie” Pullman, a bright and imaginative young boy born with facial differences who has spent much of his childhood undergoing medical procedures and being homeschooled by his mother. When his parents decide it is time for him to attend a mainstream school, Auggie faces the intimidating challenge of entering fifth grade at Beecher Prep, where his appearance immediately attracts attention from classmates. Despite his intelligence, kindness, and love for science and space, he struggles with bullying, uncomfortable stares, and the fear of being judged before anyone gets to know him. As Auggie slowly develops friendships with classmates who recognize his true personality, he begins discovering the courage to embrace his differences and believe in himself. Meanwhile, the story explores the experiences of his older sister Via, his parents, and the people around him, revealing how Auggie’s journey affects their lives in unexpected ways. From heartbreaking school experiences and difficult family conversations to acts of kindness, surprising friendships, and emotional moments of triumph, Auggie learns that acceptance often begins with understanding and compassion. Based on the bestselling novel by R. J. Palacio, the film combines heartfelt family drama, inspiring storytelling, and powerful emotional moments while celebrating kindness, courage, friendship, acceptance, and the importance of looking beyond appearances.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Family • Coming-of-Age

⭐ IMDb: 7.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 53m • PG

🎥 Director: Stephen Chbosky
